breakdown.description: Mass/volume conservation is violated for steady incompressible flow in constant area (Q cannot change from inlet to outlet).
breakdown.reason: The agent successfully identified the physical inconsistency in the original prompt. It correctly stated that for steady incompressible flow in a constant-area pipe, the principle of continuity requires the volumetric flow rate to be constant (Q_in = Q_out). By pointing out that the given unequal flow rates are physically impossible and imply other factors like leakage or errors, the agent resolved the core violation of mass conservation, which is the same principle the ground truth aimed to enforce.
